broad: regulation of ascospore wall 1,3-beta-D-glucan biosynthetic process
regulation of ascospore wall 1,3-beta-glucan biosynthetic process

definition: Any process that modulates the rate, frequency, or extent of ascospore wall (1->3)-beta-D-glucan biosynthetic process, the chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of (1->3)-beta-D-glucans, compounds composed of glucose residues linked by (1->3)-beta-D--glucosidic bonds, found in the walls of ascospores.
label: regulation of ascospore wall (1->3)-beta-D-glucan biosynthetic process
